cases.prompt: Resume the bounded synthetic build represented by fixtures/build-state.json. Do not perform Git, provider, Linear, or repository mutations. Apply the packaged skill's official-Linear-MCP orchestration contract. Validate the raw managed envelopes and every independent read receipt, derive the lifecycle only from native project-update IDs, and validate the complete increment contracts and native dependency graph before classifying the overnight handoff. Return exactly one JSON object using the keys developmentRecordTransport, mcpEndpoint, mcpPreflightVerified, projectClientId, projectNativeId, projectReadBackVerified, specificationAuthority, phaseNativeUpdateChain, incrementIssueGraph, allManagedReadBacksVerified, hardGates, terminalChoices, terminalChoice, overnightDispatchPreconditionsVerified, executionSkill, and mergeAllowed. Use the skill's user-facing labels for terminalChoices and terminalChoice.
cases.expected: One completely read authority at the official Linear MCP endpoint retains the exact managed feature project and project-update specification. The exact native phase chain reaches executionApproved, both complete increment contracts and their native dependency edge are verified before dispatch, all managed read-backs agree, exactly three explicit gates and all terminal choices remain, the selected overnight branch routes to woostack-execute-overnight, and no merge is allowed.

contract.objective: Refresh an expired cache entry from its configured source while preserving the fresh-entry fast path.

responsibilities: detect expiration before returning a cached value
replace the stale value atomically after a successful refresh
prove a fresh entry performs no refresh

tasks.expectedOutcome: fails because the expired entry remains stale while the fresh-entry case passes
passes the expired-refresh and fresh-entry cases
continues to pass after extracting the expiry predicate without changing behavior

acceptanceCriteria.text: Expired cache entries are refreshed once

acceptanceCoverage.manualVerificationStep: Inspect the refresh trace for one expired key.

automatedVerification.expectedOutcome: exit 0 with the expired-refresh and fresh-entry cases passing

manualVerification.step: Inspect the refresh trace for one expired key.
manualVerification.expectedObservation: one source read occurs before the refreshed value replaces the stale entry

contract.objective: Coalesce concurrent refreshes for one expired key so every caller observes the same refreshed value.

responsibilities: share one in-flight refresh per cache key
clear the in-flight entry after success or failure
prove concurrent callers trigger one source read
prove every caller receives the same refreshed value

tasks.expectedOutcome: fails because concurrent callers start more than one refresh
passes with exactly one source read and one shared refreshed value
both increment suites continue to pass after isolating in-flight refresh bookkeeping

acceptanceCriteria.text: Concurrent callers observe the refreshed value

acceptanceCoverage.manualVerificationStep: Inspect the concurrent refresh trace for one expired key.

automatedVerification.expectedOutcome: exit 0 with the sequential and concurrent freshness cases passing

manualVerification.step: Inspect the concurrent refresh trace for one expired key.
manualVerification.expectedObservation: one source read completes before all waiting callers receive the same value
